text: Your AI writes code in minutes. VibeForge keeps every version safe, with Meta Muse AI reviewing every milestone.
Sign in, create a space for your team, and give each person a role.
Create a project: a timeline of milestones, not commits. Each milestone is your whole app, zipped and scanned.
Create an API token in your profile. It's shown once.
Add VibeForge as an MCP server: one command in Claude Code, or a snippet for Cursor and VS Code. Connected.
Pushing is just asking. Login works: milestone one. Dark mode: milestone two. Nothing is ever overwritten.
Every milestone is scanned on arrival for leaked secrets and vulnerable packages.
For everything scanners miss, there's Meta Muse AI. In settings, switch on AI review with Meta Muse, and paste your Muse API key. It's sealed on the server. Test connection. Connected.
Pick a model. Muse Spark 1.3 is recommended, with a one million token context. The Contributor edition costs a tenth as much, and VibeForge warns you that Meta may train on that code.
Secrets are masked before any code leaves VibeForge, and you choose how much code Muse reads and how hard it thinks.

Open a milestone and run an AI review. Muse reads the whole app at once and finds what scanners can't: a live payment key in the browser, a database password in the server code, a form that lets anyone add recipes without logging in. You get a score, a grade from A to F, and issues sorted by severity.
Every issue is in plain English: why it matters, the exact file and line, and a ready-made prompt for your AI tool. Or copy one fix-all prompt, and push the next milestone to watch your grade go up.

Want Git for the small steps too? Click Set up Git, and Muse writes a gitignore and safety hooks for this exact project, in one setup script. Run it, and the pre-commit hook stops that hard-coded payment key before it's ever committed.

Before you ship, Muse writes a custom assessment. Is it internal or for customers, web or mobile, how will it deploy? Is it licensed, and is any paid or borrowed media used without permission? Admins can search every project's report in one place.
Broke something? Tell your AI: restore my folder to milestone one. It saves where you are first, so nothing is lost.
Push. Review with Meta Muse. Fix. Restore. Every version your AI builds, in one place. VibeForge.
